meta.description: Turn qualifications, availability and operational demand into mobilisable technical capacity.

landing.title: Turn qualifications, availability and demand into mobilisable technical capacity.
landing.lead: Define what you need — 2 × B1.1, A320 family, EWIS + HF + FTS, Madrid, night shift — and see immediately what your own workforce covers, what the gap is, and which professionals really qualify. Every result is explained.

register.lead: Your profile stays private by default. You decide what is visible and when.

passport.title: Your profile, connected.
passport.description: What you update here is reflected in matching and in your dossier. Qualifications and availability have their own pages.
passport.noProfileDescription: The passport belongs to professional accounts.
passport.name: Professional name
passport.visibilityIntro: Matching respects your choice. Private profiles never appear to organizations; contact always requires your consent.
passport.saved: Passport updated. Matching uses the new data.
passport.conflict: Your passport was changed in another window or device. Nothing was saved: reload the page to see the latest version, then apply your changes again.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.description: Licences, type ratings, training and approvals, with issue and expiry dates. You declare; an authorized reviewer verifies. A course must stay valid through the last day of a requirement to pass its hard filter.
qualifications.catalogErrorTitle: The qualification catalog could not be loaded
qualifications.catalogErrorDescription: Reload the page. Your declarations are safe.
qualifications.intro: Self-declared qualifications stay pending until an authorized reviewer verifies them. Only verified ones satisfy hard requirements.
qualifications.datesResetHint: Changing the dates sends it back to pending review.
qualifications.updatedReset: {code} updated — back to pending review because its dates changed.
qualifications.allDeclared: You have declared every type in the catalog.
qualifications.empty: No qualifications yet. Declare your licence and type ratings above — they enter matching once verified.
qualifications.expiryOptionalHint: Leave empty when the qualification does not expire

availability.title: Chosen availability
availability.description: A free day only enters the market when you mark it as available. Times are UTC; blocked windows override available ones.
availability.pickerHint: Select a state, then click the days to apply it. Days are UTC.
availability.coveredByLonger: {date} is covered by a longer window. Edit or delete that window in the list below.
availability.emptyHint: No availability windows yet. Mark days in the calendar or add a window above — you only enter matching when you are available for the whole requirement period.

dashboard.noRequirementsDescription: Create a requirement to see your technical capacity and the gap to cover.
dashboard.managersOnlyTitle: Capacity analysis is available to managers and admins
dashboard.managersOnlyDescription: Ask an organization admin for the manager role.

requirements.title: Work requirements
requirements.description: Operational needs, their qualifications and period. Times in UTC.
requirements.caption: Work requirements

detail.noTechniciansTitle: No technicians in your organization yet
detail.noTechniciansDescription: The whole headcount is a gap to source externally.

new.title: New work requirement
new.description: Describe the real operational need. Crew Flex evaluates your internal capacity first.
new.noPermissionDescription: Only organization managers and admins can create requirements.
new.catalogErrorTitle: The qualification catalog could not be loaded
new.qualificationsIntro: Hard requirements filter candidates out; soft ones only affect the score. At least one hard requirement is needed.
new.forbidden: Your role cannot create requirements in this organization.
new.unreachable: The service could not be reached. Your data is still here — retry.
new.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

matches.description: {location} · {period}. Hard requirements are filters: no score compensates a missing one.
matches.emptyTitle: No matchable professionals for these qualifications
matches.emptyDescription: Only professionals who chose to be matchable and hold at least one of the required qualifications are evaluated.
matches.summary: {eligible} eligible of {evaluated} evaluated. Anonymous professionals are shown with a reference that is only valid for this requirement.

coverage.complete: Every professional in the network who holds at least one required qualification was evaluated ({prefiltered}).
coverage.nearMissesTrimmed: {prefiltered} professionals hold at least one required qualification; {evaluated} were evaluated. All {hardEligible} who meet every hard requirement and are available were evaluated first; the others are the closest near misses.
coverage.eligibleTruncated: Partial result: {hardEligible} professionals meet every hard requirement and are available, but at most {cap} are evaluated per request. This list is not the whole network — narrow the requirement (period, qualifications) to see the rest.

workforce.description: Members of your organization and their qualification status. Adding members (invitations with consent) comes next.
workforce.errorTitle: The workforce could not be loaded
workforce.managersOnlyTitle: The workforce is visible to managers and admins
workforce.managersOnlyDescription: Members' qualification data is shared only with organization managers and admins.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your account and how Crew Flex looks to you. Business data lives in your passport or organization pages.
settings.languageDescription: The interface, dates and messages follow this choice on every device where you sign in. Licence codes, aircraft types and your own data are never translated.
settings.name: Name

reviews.title: Qualification review
reviews.description: Self-declared qualifications wait here until a platform administrator checks them. Only verified hard qualifications make a professional eligible.
reviews.evidenceNote: No evidence documents are stored yet (the document wallet is not built). Check each declaration with the issuing authority or the professional's original documents before verifying. Your decision and the request reference are audited.
reviews.emptyDescription: Every active declaration has been decided.
reviews.noteHint: Required to reject. Visible to the professional; do not include personal data.
reviews.verifiedDone: Verified. The qualification now counts for matching.
reviews.rejectedDone: Rejected. The professional can see the reason.
reviews.alreadyDecided: This declaration was already decided or changed. Reload the queue.
